recognize_zh: Ki-67 染色在瀰漫浸潤的淋巴瘤細胞中幾乎全數呈棕色核陽性（估計 >90%），只有右側間質內梭形細胞與少數小細胞為陰性，代表極高增生指數，符合母細胞型被套細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Diffuse sheet of medium-sized lymphoid cells on the left with nuclear Ki-67 staining in nearly all tumor cells
Estimated proliferation index greater than 90% in the tumor sheet
Right side shows looser stroma with spindle cells and scattered negative cells, plus infiltrating Ki-67-positive tumor cells
Variable staining intensity, including some cells with nucleolar accentuation
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for Ki-67 shows a diffuse infiltrate of medium-sized lymphoid cells with nuclear positivity in more than 90% of tumor cells, extending into adjacent stroma, where spindle stromal cells are negative. This very high proliferation index is an adverse prognostic feature. In a CD20-positive, cyclin D1-positive lymphoma with blastoid cytology, findings are consistent with mantle cell lymphoma, blastoid variant with a very high proliferation fraction.

ddx.vs: Ki-67 is also near 100%, but cells are CD10+/BCL6+ and BCL2 and cyclin D1 negative with MYC rearrangement.
Usually has a Ki-67 index well under 30% with small cleaved cells, whereas more than 30% defines a high-risk group typical of blastoid/pleomorphic variants.
Has a similarly high proliferation fraction but expresses TdT and lacks cyclin D1.
Also highly proliferative, but lacks cyclin D1/SOX11 and CCND1 rearrangement.
